report: JANUS Governance Challenge Harness v0.3.1 — Independent Regression, Integrity & Release-Candidate Test — raw results
tester: Claude (Cowork), driving the user's Chrome via Claude in Chrome; independent recomputation in Node v22 sandbox
method_notes: Live testing ran in the user's Chrome tab via page-context JavaScript that drove the real controls (select change events, button clicks).

Instrumentation: window.alert captured to an array; URL.createObjectURL and HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click wrapped so each export's Blob and download filename were captured in memory instead of written to disk. The final browser download step was therefore not exercised.
Fault injection used a window.fetch wrapper (byte flip, 404, network error, manifest edits, GitHub API mocks). Tamper tests mutated lastRun/lastReplay in place.
Expected contract and evidence-core hashes were independently recomputed in Node from the repository app.js + DOCX + manifest values, then injected into the page for comparison.
The cloud sandbox could not reach github.io directly (proxy 403); all live-file hashing was done in the browser.
GitHub's unauthenticated API quota ran out mid-matrix (HTTP 429). commit_verification was MATCH for the first ~25 cycles and UNAVAILABLE afterwards; this doubled as the quota-exhaustion test.

new_defects.summary: validateScenarioContract checks presence/types but not enum values or emptiness; invalid disposition, invented support status, empty commitments, and a disposition listed in its own compatibility set are accepted and export PASS; a null scenario element throws an uncaught TypeError with no visible reason.
After any Run refusal the Run button stays disabled with a valid selection; a transient network failure cannot be retried without Reset or reselection.
On a page with no prior run, changing scenario/prediction shows 'Previous result, replay, and export state were invalidated.' alongside 'No challenge has been run for this selection.'
Exported replay block (and export-time fields) are not hashed or checked; a forged lastReplay exports with integrity_status PASS. Not disclosed in integrity_scope/README.

At Run the manifest's version/build_id are not compared with the app's HARNESS_VERSION/BUILD_ID, and code_commit is trusted as asserted (corroboration checks main's app.js, not code_commit's). A wrong manifest with a correct app.js hash is accepted and recorded.
Structural tamper (harness_provenance or source_document set to null) makes Replay/Export throw uncaught TypeErrors outside their try blocks; fails closed but silently.
Export refusals appear only as alert() dialogs; divergence banner does not name failing checks; 'Failed to fetch' does not name the resource.

README 'Evidence export' still claims 'the full GitHub main commit observed at run time'; README Replay list omits code/snapshot checks; CHANGELOG lists v0.2 above v0.3; README has no v0.3 test-record section; runtime verifies only app.js though manifest lists more files.
